objection_handlers.objection: We already have a WordPress developer / SEO agency.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Perfect — we don't replace your web team or touch your WordPress theme. They paste one 28 KB script tag onto your homepage or estimate page in 5 minutes, and it immediately turns the Austin SEO traffic they're already bringing in into 2x–3x more pre-qualified inspection requests.

objection_handlers.objection: Every Austin roof is different — I don't want homeowners holding me to an online number.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Totally fair, and it never issues a binding bid. It gives an honest Central Texas ballpark range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so $5,000 tire-kickers filter themselves out before you drive across I-35, while real buyers arrive pre-educated on $13k–$35k replacement budgets.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have Forminator for free?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Forminator is a static blind form that waits for WordPress JS to load and gives zero pricing feedback, which causes mobile drop-off. Our tool is 100% branded to Austin Roofing Company, routes roof size, pitch, material, and hail urgency straight to your phone/CRM, includes quarterly Austin pricing updates, and a single closed roof replacement pays for over three years.

objection_handlers.objection: Our site is already slow — won't another widget hurt speed even more?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Quite the opposite. The entire widget is 28 KB (under 9 KB gzipped — smaller than one thumbnail on your homepage) with zero external scripts or frameworks, running in Shadow DOM so it renders instantaneously without touching Elementor or WordPress.
